code.no_tmdb_key: No TMDB API key is configured (set TMDB_API_KEY in .env).

feedback.separateHint: The two fields are processed separately, and both are optional.

reason.genre_match: Same genres as titles you rated highly ({genres}).
reason.preference: Matches something you said you like: {label}.

saBanner: The Streaming Availability source isn't configured, so arrival and departure data is missing.

updates.title: What's new
updates.hint: The year on a card is the original release year; the date in the strip is the Hungarian streaming event.
updates.emptyDefault: Nothing like this in this period.

empty.new: Nothing new arrived on your services in this period.
empty.new_season: No known new seasons in this period.
empty.watchlist_available: None of your watchlist titles became available.

leaving.title: Leaving soon
leaving.hint: Departure dates only come from a source; when unknown, the title is just marked “soon”.
leaving.empty: No titles are known to be leaving your services in this period.

home.title: For you
home.refreshing: Building new recommendations; checking TMDB availability can take a while…
home.noSubscriptions: No subscriptions are switched on, so there's nothing to recommend. Turn on your services in Settings.

onboarding.title: Let's get started
onboarding.intro: Three quick steps and recommendations will fit your services and your taste.
onboarding.step1: Which services do you subscribe to?
onboarding.step1Hint: We only recommend from these. You can change them later in Settings.
onboarding.step2: Upload your watch history and ratings
onboarding.step2Hint: IMDb ratings, IMDb watchlist and the Netflix data export. Optional: you can also mark titles with “Seen it” on any card.
onboarding.step3Hint: Finish the introduction when you're ready.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.hint: Recommendations, Discover, What's new and the chat only use the services switched on here. Cards still show availability on all six services.
subscriptions.none: No subscriptions are switched on: recommendations will be empty.

discover.title: Discover
discover.hint: Only titles from the local catalog with verified subscription availability in Hungary.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.availableOnly: Streaming now only (verified, on your subscriptions)
watchlist.hint: Imported items (Netflix, IMDb) can only be removed at their source; here you manage the app's own watchlist. A watchlist shows interest, not a rating.

resolution.title: Title matching
resolution.reimportText: Manual matches only show up in your history and watchlist after the related import is run again.

sync.title: Sync log
sync.hint: Upload files on the Import page; every import and sync run is listed here.
sync.empty: No imports or syncs have run yet.

import.title: Data sources and import
import.intro: Upload official export files. Files stay on this machine (data/imports); we never ask for or store passwords.
import.uploaded: Upload complete, the import has started.
import.noProfiles: No profiles were found in the export.

hint.imdb_ratings: On IMDb, open “Your Ratings” and pick “Export” from the menu at the top right. Download the CSV when it's ready and upload it here.
hint.imdb_watchlist: On IMDb, open your watchlist and choose “Export this list”. Upload the downloaded CSV here.
hint.netflix_export: Netflix account → Security & privacy → “Download your personal information”. The ZIP usually arrives by email within a few days; upload it as is, without unzipping.

unsupported.disney_plus_export: You can get your Disney+ watch history through a GDPR data request, but there's no automatic import for it yet. Until then, mark titles you've watched with “Seen it” on the cards.
unsupported.hbo_max_export: You can get your HBO Max watch history through a GDPR data request, but there's no automatic import for it yet. Until then, mark titles you've watched with “Seen it” on the cards.
unsupported.prime_video_export: You can get your Prime Video watch history through a GDPR data request, but there's no automatic import for it yet. Until then, mark titles you've watched with “Seen it” on the cards.
unsupported.apple_tv_export: You can get your Apple TV+ watch history through a GDPR data request, but there's no automatic import for it yet. Until then, mark titles you've watched with “Seen it” on the cards.
unsupported.skyshowtime_export: You can get your SkyShowtime watch history through a GDPR data request, but there's no automatic import for it yet. Until then, mark titles you've watched with “Seen it” on the cards.

import.unsupportedGeneric: You can get your {provider} watch history through a GDPR data request, but there's no automatic import for that format yet. Until then, mark titles you've watched with “Seen it” on the cards.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataSourcesHint: Upload IMDb ratings, your IMDb watchlist and the Netflix data export, and see what's not possible yet for the other services.
settings.languageHint: Language of the interface and of the chat's answers.
settings.netflixProfileHint: Whose history to import from the Netflix export.
settings.netflixProfileNone: No Netflix export has been uploaded yet, so there are no profiles to choose from.

refresh.title: Catalog refresh
refresh.hint: Fetches availability changes, new arrivals and notifications. This can take up to a minute.

env.title: Environment and LLM
env.hint: Read-only. These come from the backend's environment variables (see .env.example); secrets are never shown.

chat.title: Ask for ideas
chat.backendNote: Titles and availability come from the backend; the model only words the answer.
chat.empty: Ask away, e.g. “Something light and funny on Netflix tonight” or “What's on my watchlist that I can stream now?”
chat.placeholder: Describe what you're in the mood for… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.placeholderCompact: Ask for a pick, e.g. “a short, clever crime show for tonight”
